title: Battery
description: Battery state of one pack: charge percentage, voltage and current on the polling interval, plus a Record at each charging session boundary

event.description: What this Record is: a periodic reading, or a charging session boundary

power_supply_status.description: Charging state reported by the pack

current.description: Pack current in Ampere, negative when discharging

capacity.description: Capacity in Ah the pack holds today

design_capacity.description: Capacity in Ah the pack was built to hold

health_percentage.description: Capacity against design capacity, 0-100. Absent unless the hardware reports both

power_supply_health.description: Health reported by the pack. Absent when the hardware reports it as unknown

power_supply_technology.description: Cell chemistry. Absent when the hardware reports it as unknown

location.description: Where the pack is mounted, as the hardware reports it

serial_number.description: Pack serial number, as the hardware reports it

completed_cycles.description: Completed charge cycles since the Measurement started, accumulated from discharge depth: two half discharges are one cycle

session_id.description: Charging session this Record belongs to, counted from 1. Present on a session boundary, and on a sample taken while a session is open

duration_sec.description: How long the charging session lasted

discharge_depth_percent.description: Percentage points discharged since the previous session ended (or since the first sample, for the first session)

start_percentage.description: Charge percentage when the session started

end_percentage.description: Charge percentage when the session ended

charged_percent.description: Percentage points gained over the session
